limitations: Reused exact PSS780 Sine99 tail supplied calibration evidence; TX81Z analogy suggested18dB threshold. This is not an independent hardware holdout or uniquely identified law.
Other raw cap rates, RKS/reset behavior, absolute-vs-relative threshold, per-operator-vs-carrier trigger and effect-toggle semantics remain unresolved.

The three focus patch modulator RR/SRR rates are at or slower than raw4. Their own release path cannot identify trigger coupling. Full-tour focus differences can arise from earlier preset tails/allocator history.
Known ReverbON in tour justifies matching fixture state, not a claim that this envelope cap is the exact circuit implementation.
Longer release increases12voice pressure and oldest replacement; actual hardware allocator still unidentified.96dB endpoint and48tick stolen fade remain existing hypotheses.
The final chord interval is polyphonic with chorus and unknown capture dynamics. No new isolated unprocessed ReverbOFF/ON pair. Pair RMS matching discards absolute gain evidence.
No per-preset tuning, timing/phase/pitch search or additive noise. Source recording/derived audio remain ignored and local.
